name: Thunderstone Cascade Trap AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God
description: A trip wire halfway up the stairs releases half a dozen spherical thunderstones that bounce down the stairs and explode.
disable: DC 27 Thievery (expert) to safely cut the trip wire

generalAbilities.name: Thunderstone Explosion
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The trip wire is disturbed

Effect Several thunderstones bounce down the stairs and explode. Each creature within 10 feet of the lower half of the stairs takes 6d10 Sonic Damage damage (Basic DC 24 Fortitude Saving Throw save). Creatures that fail this save are additionally Deafened for 1 minute; creatures that critically fail this save are instead deafened for 1 hour.
